title: Forgiveness in one shorter sitting
subtitle: A compact bundle for forgiveness
description: The mind knows the wound but does not know how to loosen its grip. This shorter bundle keeps one guidance card, one topic guide, and one shabad together so the archive stays usable on busy days.
